What’s your typical project timeline?: I build AI-powered products, web and mobile applications, and cloud-connected software. I focus on practical tools that solve a clear problem and are simple to use.
Do you offer revisions?: I can help explore features such as AI assistants, search, and workflow automation. We’ll first check your use case, data, privacy needs, and budget to decide where AI would be useful.
What do you need from me to get started?: A short description of the problem, who the product is for, and the main features you need is a good starting point. Existing code, designs, references, and any timeline or budget constraints also help.
Do you provide post-project support?: Deployment and handover can be included in the project scope. We’ll agree on hosting, configuration, documentation, and any ongoing support before work begins.
What’s the best way to reach you?: Use the Contact page to share your idea, goals, and any existing work. We can discuss the scope, technical approach, and next steps from there.
Can you work with my existing brand guid: Yes. I can review an existing application and help plan improvements, fix issues, or add features. The first step is understanding the codebase, its current setup, and what you want to change.
